name: visible-compact
description: Shows the conversation before and after /compact side by side in a pane; /show-last-compact reopens it

storage.title: Where compactions are saved
storage.description: temp, home or memory. temp (default): the OS temp folder. home: ~/.claude/visible-compact. memory: nothing written to disk; gone when Claude Code exits. On disk, compactions are cleared after Claude Code's cleanupPeriodDays (30 days unless set); cleanupPeriodDays 0 means memory. Any other value is treated as temp.
